bio.text: Flavio Bravo, a Democrat, represents District 26, which includes Phoenix and Glendale, in the Arizona State Senate.
According to his legislative biography, Bravo is a fifth-generation Arizonan, was born and raised in the 26th district, and lives in west Phoenix.

He earned a Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy and Political Science from Loyola University Chicago, a Master of Arts in Migration Studies from the University of San Francisco, and an MBA from Arizona State University's W.P. Carey School of Business.
